meta.source: WB reviews (data/wb.parquet), no dates in the data; niche found by review text
meta.student: ruBert-base on 20k teacher labels (reports/student.md): need score, reasons ≥ 0.5, sentiment
meta.themes: Qwen3-14B Q4_K_M, themes named in one request per product over up to 300 reviews, then every review tagged with the themes in its own request; share = tagged reviews / reviews read
meta.seller_answers: template = after normalising (lower case, no names, digits, punctuation) equal or near (difflib ratio >= 0.9 or common prefix >= 80%) to >= 2 other answers on the product
meta.privacy: names, phones, e-mails and links masked in every quote
